text: At its meeting on May 25, 2026, the Toronto Public Library Board considered the report (May 15, 2026) from the Auditor General on Cybersecurity Audit of Toronto Public Library, and made recommendations to City Council.
City Council on July 29 and 30, 2026, adopted the following: 1. City Council receive the report (May 15, 2026) from the Auditor General for information.
